model_annotation: The figure illustrates the relationship between the average lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different methods, including Consistency-CE, Consistency-Bi + sampling, and Consistency-Bi + beam. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", has a scale type that is linear, with a value range of 20 to 30, tick label interval of 2, and no units provided. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", also has a linear scale type, with a value range of 0 to 8, and no units provided. The graph features three lines, each representing one of the methods, with distinct colors, shapes, and styles: Consistency-CE is depicted as a blue dashed line with circles, Consistency-Bi + sampling as an orange dashed line with triangles, and Consistency-Bi + beam as a green dashed line with squares. The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately 20 BLEU and increases to 28 BLEU as AL increases from 0 to 8, while the Consistency-Bi + sampling line starts at around 24 BLEU and reaches 29 BLEU over the same range, and the Consistency-Bi + beam line begins at about 24 BLEU and also reaches 29 BLEU. A legend at the bottom of the figure provides a color-to-label mapping for each method.
